falsifiers: H < 4% of decode time on development prompts (not enough transfer latency overlaps a compute window)
the deferred wait cannot be implemented with identical tokens, zero budget violations, no pending reads and a faithful baseline (synchronisation or ownership prevents overlap)
the mechanism campaign shows no reduction of exposed wait against C0, or fewer than a quarter of deferred bytes arrive in time (causal information arrives too late)
the mechanism is present but the primary lower bound stays below 2% (hidden stall does not reach end-to-end time, or concurrent transfers slow compute)
miss bytes or evictions change beyond 1% (the change is not pure scheduling)
harm above 2% at 4 GiB or inconsistency across prompts

hypotheses.H_headroom: Before evaluation, on development prompts, the one-shot trace-derived hideable bound H is at least 4% of decode time.
hypotheses.H_mechanism: C lowers the critical-path wait inside the expert-store hook relative to the bookkeeping-matched control C0, at least a quarter of deferred read bytes complete before they are needed, and wait reduction accounts for at least half of C's reduction of store-hook time.
hypotheses.H_no_harm: At 4 GiB, C is not slower than A by more than 2.0% (95% upper bound).
hypotheses.H_null: The relative reduction is below 2.0% (including zero or a slowdown).
hypotheses.H_primary: C lowers decode wall ms/token relative to A at 1.5 GiB: the 95% lower bound of the mean block relative reduction is >= 2.0%.
